result.description:
Our client, Tech Envision, is a technology solutions provider located in Warrnambool, Victoria, specialising in telecommunications, networking, information technology (IT) infrastructure, and digital technology services. The company delivers end-to-end solutions including network design, telecommunications system deployment, infrastructure implementation, technical support, and ongoing maintenance for business clients. 

Tech Envision is seeking a Telecommunications Field Engineer to install, commission, maintain, troubleshoot, and support telecommunications and network infrastructure at customer sites. The role involves delivering field engineering services, ensuring reliable network performance, resolving technical issues, and providing high-quality customer support while complying with industry standards and safety requirements.

The annual salary for this position is $75,000 to $85,000.

Duties include:

•	Conduct site surveys to assess customer requirements, network infrastructure, equipment locations, and installation feasibility for telecommunications projects. 

•	Install, configure, commission, and test telecommunications equipment, including routers, switches, wireless devices, fibre optic systems, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) solutions, and network hardware to meet technical specifications. 

•	Perform fault diagnosis, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on telecommunications networks and associated equipment to ensure continuous service availability. 

•	Monitor network performance using diagnostic tools and protocol analysers, identifying faults and implementing technical solutions to optimise system reliability and efficiency. 

•	Configure Internet Protocol (IP) networking, routing, switching, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), and wireless communication systems in accordance with customer requirements and industry standards. 

•	Conduct fibre optic cable testing, splicing verification, signal measurements, and certification using specialised test equipment to ensure network integrity and performance. 

•	Prepare technical documentation, including installation reports, network diagrams, test results, maintenance records, and equipment configuration details for project completion and compliance purposes. 

•	Provide onsite technical support and troubleshooting for customers, resolving hardware, software, connectivity, and telecommunications service issues within agreed service levels. 

•	Coordinate with Project Managers, Network Engineers, vendors, and customers during installation, commissioning, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure successful project delivery. 

•	Ensure all telecommunications installations and field activities comply with workplace health and safety requirements, telecommunications regulations, and company quality standards. 

•	Perform system upgrades, firmware updates, equipment replacements, and network expansion activities with minimal disruption to customer operations. 

•	Assist in evaluating new telecommunications technologies, conducting field testing and performance validation, and recommending improvements to enhance network capability, reliability, and customer service outcomes.

Qualifications:

•	Must have at least one (1) year of experience.

•	Should hold a Diploma or higher qualification in a relevant field.

Randstad is proud to partner with Queensland Rail (QR) on a major recruitment drive to source engineering professionals. As part of this major recruitment drive, we are looking to identify an experienced Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS for the ETCS Sequence Alliance (Embedded) division.  
  QR has a current project pipeline of over A$15 billion, and this is expected to grow exponentially in the build-up to the 2032 Brisbane Olympic and Paralympic Games.. As a result of this significant investment, the need to secure in-house technical and engineering resources is paramount to support their critical technology rollouts. This includes ensuring that European Train Control Systems (ETCS) telecommunications networks are technically robust and compliant across the network.  
  What You'll Do  
  The Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS will provide specialist engineering services and technical leadership to project-based teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that ETCS telecommunications networks are technically robust, commercially optimized, and seamlessly integrated.  
 
  Drive Engineering Excellence  : Monitor and influence ETCS Cross River Rail (CRR) telecommunications data system projects, ensuring peak performance levels are achieved at competitive costs. You will ensure that integration into the QR data network never compromises reliability, availability, or maintainability.  
  Coach & Inspire:   Lead the facilitation of technical training and competency development for telecommunications office and field staff, ensuring a powerful capability uplift and compliance across teams.  
  Innovate & Optimize  : Ensure technical standards and procedures are meticulously documented and applied in accordance with Queensland Rail Quality Assurance and Improvement Principles.  
  Thought Leader  : Provide strategic technical leadership and advice to business groups, technical staff, and external stakeholders, ensuring complex network solutions align perfectly with QR's operational requirements.  
   Uphold Integrity : Champion strict compliance with professional engineering practices, Queensland Rail standards, and all corporate legal and safety obligations.  
 
  What We Are Looking For  
  We are looking for a strong implementor in the network engineering space who brings a deep understanding of data communications, commercial acumen, and high-level stakeholder management skills.  
 
  Qualifications  : A Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical & Electronic)   AND   ideally   current Registered Professional Engineer Queensland (RPEQ) status   or   have the necessary qualifications and experience to attain it. IE: have CEng or Professional Engineer status with Engineers Australia.  
  Network Telecoms Experience:   Extensive knowledge of LAN/WAN data communications, and physical network security applicable to a railway network. You must bring high-level skills in the design, system configuration, construction, auditing, commissioning, integration, and technical support of telecommunications network systems. Candidates would ideally come from a client or contractor background and have strong implementation experience.  
  Analytical & Technical Depth:   Extensive knowledge of telecommunications performance and integration principles, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to keep ETCS CRR projects operationally effective.  
  Commercial Acumen:   A proven track record of delivering business-focused technical and professional network solutions that bring tangible commercial value to the business.  
  Soft Skills & Influence  : High levels of interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation skills.  
 
  Queensland Rail is a progressive organisation that promotes a flexible working environment to allow for a healthy work-life balance. It actively prioritizes the development of its people in a supportive, diverse, and inclusive work culture.  
  QR offers the following benefits:  
 
  Competitive remuneration packages  
  Comprehensive relocation assistance (if applicable)  
  A long-term consistent pipeline of work, offering job security and stellar opportunities for technical and professional development  
 
  Why choose Queensland to live and work?  
  More people from within Australia are migrating to Queensland than to any other state! It's hard not to see why, with a fantastic climate, affordable housing, stunning beaches, national parks, and one of the great wonders of the world - The Great Barrier Reef, Queensland has it all.  
  How to apply  
  If you want to grasp this life changing opportunity then please click apply.   For more information visit our landing page www.randstad.com.au/rail-australia/  

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.

result.description:
The Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer who will single-handedly analyse, design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack operational systems serving Chinese clients across semiconductor, MCU, and cross-border business domains. This is not a narrowly scoped position — the successful candidate must independently manage the complete lifecycle of multiple concurrent software systems, from requirements gathering with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders through to production deployment on China-compliant infrastructure.

The role requires a rare combination of full-stack software engineering, hands-on Linux server administration, working familiarity with IC design and EDA tool environments, and the ability to operate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese across technical, business, and compliance contexts. The candidate will be the primary technical owner of all systems and must be capable of working without supervision across all layers of the stack and across all stages of delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack web applications end-to-end — including React or Vue front-end interfaces, Python-based backend services, relational databases, RESTful APIs, authentication systems, and administrative dashboards — within a single-engineer ownership model.
- Build and maintain internal tools, management systems, workflow dashboards, and client-facing operational platforms for cross-border Chinese SMEs, semiconductor companies, and engineering teams, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms (WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-specific cloud APIs) using Chinese-language API documentation.
- Develop and maintain software tools, scripts, and workflow automation systems that support IC design operations, including DFT workflows, Verilog-based digital logic design, verification pipelines, and EDA tool environments (Cadence and Synopsys) — covering environment configuration, licence server management, and build-flow automation.
- Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain applications on Linux-based server environments across Mainland China and international infrastructure, including ICP-filed domains, China-based hosting, cross-border DNS and CDN configuration, reverse proxy setup (Nginx), and environment-specific application configuration. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues specific to China-facing deployments, including Great Firewall constraints and dual-environment architectures.
- Identify technology limitations, performance bottlenecks, and process gaps across existing systems, then independently design, implement, and document improvements — maintaining technical documentation, API references, deployment runbooks, and operational procedures in both English and Chinese.
- Analyse operational metrics, system performance data, user feedback, and error reports to drive continuous improvement across all systems under management.
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for bilingual teams, Chinese clients, and stakeholders across China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia, conducting requirements gathering and technical communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Technical Requirements

Required

- Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver complete systems from front-end to backend to deployment.
- Strong proficiency in Python as a primary backend language, with production experience in Django, Flask, or FastAPI for building database-backed web applications and API services.
- Production experience developing front-end interfaces using React or Vue (not merely prototyping), including state management, component architecture, API integration, and responsive design.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining internal tools, admin panels, operational dashboards, and workflow management platforms for business users.
- Solid understanding of RESTful API design, relational database modelling (PostgreSQL or MySQL), authentication and authorisation systems, third-party API integration, and system-to-system communication patterns.
- Hands-on Linux server administration experience, including setup, configuration, application deployment, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS management, firewall rules, log management, cron jobs, process supervision, and production troubleshooting — not merely development on Linux.
- Practical experience with Docker containerisation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, and cloud or hybrid server deployment environments.
- Working knowledge of digital IC design workflows, including an understanding of DFT (Design for Test) concepts, Verilog HDL, digital logic design, synthesis, and verification processes — sufficient to develop, configure, and maintain software tools and workflow integrations that support IC design engineering teams.
- Direct experience working with EDA tool environments, specifically Cadence and/or Synopsys toolchains, including at least one of: tool installation and environment configuration, licence server setup and management, build-flow scripting and automation, or integration of EDA tools into broader engineering workflow platforms.
- Familiarity with ARM Cortex and/or RISC-V processor architectures and MCU-based development workflows, with sufficient understanding to build and maintain software systems that support semiconductor engineering and production operations.
- Demonstrated experience with Mainland China infrastructure and compliance requirements, including ICP filing processes, China-based hosting configuration, China-accessible domain and DNS setup, and deployment of applications that function reliably behind the Great Firewall.
- Experience building operational software systems for Chinese businesses, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms, services, or APIs (e.g., WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-based cloud providers), with the ability to independently read and implement from Chinese-language technical documentation.

Preferred

- Experience developing automation scripts, engineering workflow tools, internal development platforms, or integration layers specifically for semiconductor or IC design teams in China.
- Understanding of MCU, semiconductor, embedded systems, or IC design industries in Greater China and broader Asia, particularly where software platforms support engineering, production, or client delivery workflows.
- Experience with software performance optimisation, security hardening, monitoring and alerting systems, and deployment automation for production environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
- Familiarity with cross-border data handling, dual-environment deployment architectures (China/international), and the operational constraints of running software services that must function in both mainland Chinese and international network environments simultaneously.
- Experience working in small teams or as a sole technical operator with full ownership of systems from requirements through to production support.

Language & Communication

- Proficient in English.
- Fluent Mandarin Chinese, both spoken and written, is required.
- Ability to communicate technical requirements, system issues, software specifications, and deployment matters with Chinese clients and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
- Ability to read and interpret Chinese platform documentation, API documentation, compliance materials, and technical communication; draft technical communications in Chinese for mainland stakeholders; and navigate Chinese-language developer resources, forums, and support channels without assistance.

result.description:
Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled Telecommunications Field Engineer to install, maintain and support telecommunications infrastructure across a range of environments. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable network performance, resolving technical issues in the field, and supporting the integration of telecommunications systems with IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented, and experienced in working with complex network and communication technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Install, configure and commission telecommunications equipment including routers, switches, cabling and transmission systems
Integrate telecommunications networks with computer systems, hardware, software and operating environments
Diagnose and resolve faults in network infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and service disruption
Monitor network performance and conduct routine maintenance to optimise system reliability and efficiency
Maintain accurate records of equipment, configurations, inventory and service activities
Prepare and update technical documentation, including procedures, policies and compliance standards
Provide technical support and guidance to clients, stakeholders and internal teams
Conduct site inspections, testing and troubleshooting of telecommunications systems in field environments
Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations and organisational quality requirements
Coordinate with vendors, service providers and project teams to support installations and upgrades
Support the deployment of new technologies, upgrades and network expansions
Respond to service requests and incidents within agreed service level timeframes
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, IT or a related field
Proven experience in telecommunications field engineering, network installation or technical support roles
Strong knowledge of networking principles (LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, routing and switching)
Experience with telecommunications equipment, cabling standards and transmission technologies
Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in field-based environments
Familiarity with operating systems, databases and system integration concepts
Excellent problem-solving, analytical and organisational skills
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
Ability to work independently and manage multiple service tasks effectively
Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel to various job sites
Preferred Qualifications
Industry certifications such as Cisco (CCNA/CCNP), CompTIA Network+ or equivalent
Experience with fibre optics, wireless networks or mobile telecommunications systems
Knowledge of network monitoring tools and diagnostic software
Experience working in large-scale infrastructure or enterprise environments
Understanding of Australian telecommunications standards and compliance requirements
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work on diverse and large-scale telecommunications projects
Supportive and collaborative team environment
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
Career progression within a growing organisation
Competitive salary package with additional benefits
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
